# Live API mapping

Every path from a cmdAbl command to Live, oriented on the
[Live Object Model](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/). cmdAbl names things as the LOM does, so that a
later switch from the Remote Script to an SDK call touches an adapter (`src/extension.ts`) and the entry in
the tables below, not the modules.

## cmdAbl path ↔ LOM path

A cmdAbl path names an object by its names (`/Vermona MIDI/Drum Rack/Kick`); every object also has a LOM
path, built from its scope and position (`lomPath`). The scope selects the LOM list:

| Scope | LOM list |
| --- | --- |
| `regular` | `tracks` |
| `return` | `return_tracks` |
| `master` | `master_track` |

| Kind | Scope | cmdAbl path | LOM path |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| track | regular | `/Bass` | `live_set tracks 2` |
| return track | return | `/A-Reverb` | `live_set return_tracks 0` |
| main track | master | `/Main` | `live_set master_track` |
| device | regular | `/Bass/Operator` | `live_set tracks 2 devices 0` |
| rack chain | regular | `/Bass/Drum Rack/Kick Chain` | `live_set tracks 2 devices 1 chains 0` |
| device in a chain | regular | `/Bass/Drum Rack/Kick Chain/Simpler` | `live_set tracks 2 devices 1 chains 0 devices 0` |

## Port methods ↔ SDK call or script operation ↔ LOM

What a module's port method does in Live. `sdk` calls need no Remote Script; `script` ones need it.

| Port method | Via | SDK call / operation | LOM | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bridge.available` | script | operation `hello` (cached answer) | – | The handshake: is the script installed, running and the right protocol version. |
| `bridge.ping` | script | operation `hello` (fresh) | – | Used for status and timing. |
| `bridge.request` | script | any operation listed in remote-script.md | – | The LOM properties each operation reads or writes are listed per operation in the Remote Script table below. |
| `bridge.state` | platform | the client's last known state | – |  |
| `bridge.close` | platform | closes the local socket | – |  |
| `liveSet.nodes` | sdk | `application.song.tracks`, `returnTracks`, `mainTrack`; `track.name`; `track.devices[i].name` | [`Song.tracks`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/song/), [`Song.return_tracks`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/song/), [`Song.master_track`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/song/), [`Track.name`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/), [`Track.devices`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/), [`Device.name`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/device/) | Tracks and devices come from the SDK; chain and drum pad nodes come from the script operation `chains` (the SDK has no chain names yet) — see the script table. |
| `tracks.transaction` | sdk | `context.withinTransaction(fn)` | – | One undo step for everything written inside. Comparable to the Python API's begin_undo_step / end_undo_step, which the script's chain_set uses; not in the LOM reference. How the SDK builds it is not documented. |
| `tracks.track` | sdk | `application.song.tracks[i]` / `returnTracks[i]` / `[mainTrack]` by the node's scope and route | [`Song.tracks`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/song/), [`Song.return_tracks`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/song/), [`Song.master_track`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/song/) | Position-based: after a Set change the index may hold another track. |
| `tracks.track().mute` | sdk | `track.mute` | [`Track.mute`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) |  |
| `tracks.track().solo` | sdk | `track.solo` | [`Track.solo`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) |  |
| `tracks.track().arm` | sdk | `track.arm` | [`Track.arm`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) | Live refuses some tracks silently; `can_be_armed` and the verification come from the script (operation `track_facts`). |
| `dialog` | sdk | the SDK's modal dialog (`context.ui`, a data: URL page) through the dialog queue | – |  |
| `log` | platform | `console.log` in the Extension Host | – |  |
| `pick` | platform | the platform's pick list | – |  |
| `onPick` | platform | listener on the pick list | – |  |
| `showFeedback` | platform | the platform's message dialog | – |  |
| `registerProvider` | platform | palette item provider | – |  |
| `onCommandRun` | platform | listener after a command finished | – |  |
| `commands.add` | platform | declares a node on the command tree | – |  |

## Remote Script operations ↔ LOM

What each operation reads (`get`), writes (`set`) or calls. A member the LOM reference does not document is
marked; it exists in the Python API the script uses.

| Operation | LOM members | SDK alternative |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hello` | – | none (this is the bridge's own handshake) |
| `select` | [`Song.view`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/song/) (get; Song.View)<br>[`Song.View.selected_track`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/song_view/) (set; Track; getsetobserve)<br>[`Song.View.selected_track`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/song_view/) (get; Track; read back with != (wrappers, never `is`))<br>[`Song.View.select_device`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/song_view/) (call; function(device); the track is not shown automatically; the device becomes the appointed device only if its track is selected)<br>[`Track.view`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) (get; Track.View)<br>[`Track.View.selected_device`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track_view/) (get; Device; get, observe: read back after select_device)<br>[`Device.view`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/device/) (get; Device.View; RackDevice.View for racks)<br>[`RackDevice.View.selected_chain`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/rackdevice_view/) (set; Chain; getsetobserve; selects the chain in the rack, also Drum Rack pads' chains)<br>[`RackDevice.View.selected_chain`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/rackdevice_view/) (get; Chain)<br>[`Track.name`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) (get; symbol; the identity check against expectName (Device.name / Chain.name likewise))<br>[`Device.name`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/device/) (get; symbol)<br>[`Chain.name`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/chain/) (get; unicode)<br>[`Track.group_track`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) (get; Track; None when the track is not grouped (the Max reference says id 0))<br>[`Track.is_foldable`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) (get; bool; reference: Instrument and Drum Racks return 0 even though they can open and close; group tracks are 1)<br>[`Track.fold_state`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) (get; int; only available if is_foldable = 1)<br>[`Track.fold_state`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) (set; int; 0 unfolds a collapsed parent group so the object is visible)<br>[`Track.can_show_chains`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) (get; bool)<br>[`Track.is_showing_chains`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) (get; bool)<br>[`Track.is_showing_chains`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) (set; bool; set to true only, never folds; to confirm in Live for Drum Rack tracks)<br>+ walks the route (below) | none yet (the SDK has no selection or view access) |
| `track_facts` | [`Track.can_be_armed`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) (get; bool; reference: 0 for return and master tracks; verified in Live: also true for a MIDI track whose input device is unavailable)<br>[`Track.arm`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) (get; bool; not in return/master tracks; read only when can_be_armed; the SDK's read of arm was wrong in Live)<br>[`Track.is_foldable`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) (get; bool; reference: Instrument and Drum Racks return 0; group tracks are 1)<br>[`Track.is_grouped`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) (get; bool)<br>[`Track.name`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) (get; symbol; returned only when no expectName was given)<br>+ walks the route (below) | partly: the SDK has Track.arm (its read was wrong in Live) and groupTrack (gives isGrouped only); nothing for is_foldable or can_be_armed |
| `chains` | [`Chain.name`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/chain/) (get; unicode; the SDK's Chain has no name)<br>[`Chain.mute`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/chain/) (get; bool; 1 = muted (Chain Activator off))<br>[`Chain.solo`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/chain/) (get; bool; 1 = soloed)<br>[`DrumChain.in_note`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/drumchain/) (get; int; available since Live 12.3; -1 = All Notes; unverified in Live)<br>[`Device.can_have_drum_pads`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/device/) (get; bool; 1 for Drum Racks; always readable)<br>[`RackDevice.has_drum_pads`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/rackdevice/) (get; bool; only available for Drum Racks (raises elsewhere): read after can_have_drum_pads)<br>+ walks the route (below) | none yet (SDK Chain has no name; DrumChain.receivingNote may cover in_note) |
| `chain_set` | [`Chain.name`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/chain/) (get; unicode; the identity check against expectName)<br>[`Chain.mute`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/chain/) (get; bool; read back after the write)<br>[`Chain.mute`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/chain/) (set; bool; 1 = muted (Chain Activator off))<br>[`Chain.solo`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/chain/) (get; bool; read back after the write)<br>[`Chain.solo`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/chain/) (set; bool; does not turn Solo off in other chains)<br>[`Song.begin_undo_step`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/song/) (call; function(); not in the LOM reference; not in the reference's Song page (it lists undo/redo only); guarded, one undo step per command)<br>[`Song.end_undo_step`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/song/) (call; function(); not in the LOM reference; not in the reference's Song page; guarded)<br>+ walks the route (below) | none yet (the SDK's Chain has no mute or solo) |

### Walking the route

Every operation that takes `{scope, route}` finds its object through these members:

| LOM member |
| --- |
| [`Song.tracks`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/song/) (get; list of Track) |
| [`Song.return_tracks`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/song/) (get; list of Track) |
| [`Song.master_track`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/song/) (get; Track) |
| [`Track.devices`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/track/) (get; list of Device; includes the mixer device per the reference) |
| [`Chain.devices`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/chain/) (get; list of Device) |
| [`RackDevice.chains`](https://docs.cycling74.com/apiref/lom/rackdevice/) (get; list of Chain) |

## Runs through the script today

The checklist for an SDK update: each item below is done by the Remote Script because the SDK did not offer
it when this page was generated. When the SDK grows the call, switch the adapter, re-run
`npm run docs:reference` and move the item to the `sdk` rows above.

- `select` — none yet (the SDK has no selection or view access)
- `track_facts` — partly: the SDK has Track.arm (its read was wrong in Live) and groupTrack (gives isGrouped only); nothing for is_foldable or can_be_armed
- `chains` — none yet (SDK Chain has no name; DrumChain.receivingNote may cover in_note)
- `chain_set` — none yet (the SDK's Chain has no mute or solo)
